versions.content: When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyRxIndica- tion API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkRxIndication callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyRxIndication call: • PduInfoPtr The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyRxIndication shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkRxIndication call- back.
